integration_notes: The canonical CLI remains international_coverage_audit.py; the engine and ISO table are internal small modules, not alternate runtimes.
The auditor imports existing market/source/shared-family registries and performs no network I/O.
Short ISO tokens are matched only as path segments to avoid provenance collisions such as AUT -> auth_*.
Test files are excluded from code/runtime provenance.
TED_EFORMS market membership is projected through the concrete active TED registry source; strategic shared families without a concrete active source are not promoted to executable coverage.
The dedicated workflow generates deterministic JSON and Markdown artifacts and validates their contract.
No country/source state, runtime registry, production deployment, or Master Queue item is modified.

generated_artifact_run.note: first artifact exposed provenance/ISO defects and was treated as a test finding, not canonical truth

rollback: Revert PR #192, or delete all files listed in files_added. No pre-existing global registry/runtime file requires restoration.
